Na tabela, a linha \"Nova mensagem\" tem: In the table, the "New message" row has a "Push" column. This switch enables notifications on the device you are using: when you turn it on, the browser asks permission to show notifications, and you tap Allow. It applies only to that device, so do this on your phone, inside the app. In this screenshot, the browser had blocked notifications: that is why you see "The browser blocked notifications. Allow them in the site settings and reload." and the switch is gray and does not respond to clicks. It looks enabled, but the device will not show any notifications until you allow them in the browser. Just below, the row explains that turning off this Push switch disables all notifications outside the app on that device.
\"Divulgação de pagamento no atendimento: "Payment disclosure in conversations" determines what happens when the first message to a contact goes out without disclosing that a virtual assistant is handling the conversation. "Inject" adds the notice, and "Block" prevents sending and asks the AI to rewrite it. It only acts if the company has a disclosure message saved. When enabled, "Check promises before sending" makes the AI reread each message to avoid promising something the company cannot deliver. It works alongside a fixed check that always runs, and each reread costs one extra AI call. Here you choose the default: each company can change its own setting in the agent's safety panel. Here disclosure is set to "Inject", and the promise check is enabled by default.
Depois de instalar, o passo a passo do c: After installation, the phone instructions tell you to enable alerts under "Notifications", also in Settings. At the top of that screen, the "Receive on your phone: install the app" link takes you back to the App on your phone screen. The notice box just below tells you whether the system can notify you even when closed. Here it says notifications only appear while the website is open: a server setting is missing, which the server administrator fixes by updating the installation. The commands shown there are for the person managing the server, not for you. The last line explains that email notifications are not available yet: that is why the table's Email column is grayed out.
A coluna da direita é a ficha do cliente: The right column is the customer's profile. At the top are the customer's phone number and labels. Below are "Conversation tags", which apply only to this conversation, and "Open requests" (what they asked for that has not been resolved yet). Scroll down the profile to see "Recent leads" (their deals in the pipeline) and "Recent orders". All without leaving the conversation. Other sections, such as "About the company" and "Tasks for this request", are covered in the lesson on the profile. On wide computer screens, it stays visible (you can hide it with "Collapse"); on a phone, open it with the "Profile" button.
A aba \"API Oficial (Meta)\" liga o núme: The "Official API (Meta)" tab connects the official WhatsApp Business number without a QR code. You need an app created in Meta for this. All three details come from that app, under WhatsApp → API Setup: the phone number ID, the WhatsApp Business account ID, and the access token. When you click "Validate and connect", the system checks the details with Meta before saving them. If the number does not respond, nothing is saved. After connecting, check the box just below: if it says "Paste this into the Meta dashboard", copy the values to Meta's dashboard, or customer replies will not arrive.
O primeiro quadro mostra os catálogos ac: The first box shows the catalogs accepted on this server. A catalog is a file listing the extensions that can be installed. For each one, you see its source address, the file's "Revision", the date it was admitted, and its "fingerprint": the beginning of a code that identifies that exact file, useful when talking to support. The system does not verify who wrote the catalog: only admit files from sources you trust. A new installation shows "No catalogs admitted yet": while that is the case, there are no extensions to install.
Ao clicar em \"Conectar novo WhatsApp\",: Clicking "Connect new WhatsApp" opens a window with two ways to connect the number. Under "QR Code", open WhatsApp on your phone, go to Linked devices → Link a device, and scan the code on the screen. Under "Connect with code", enter the phone number with country and area codes, click "Generate code", and enter the code shown on your phone. Once the phone confirms, you see "WhatsApp connected!" and the badge on the number's card turns green, showing "Connected". Every new number starts in test mode: the AI does not reply to anyone until you authorize it.
Cada linha é um pedido, e o que vence pr: Each row is a request, with the earliest deadline first. "Type" tells you what the customer requested: "Data request" means a copy of their data; "Customer anonymization" means deleting personal data. "Subject" is the customer's number in the online store. "Received" shows how long ago the request arrived, and "Due" shows the time left (in red when less than 2 days remain; after the deadline, it shows "overdue today" or the number of days overdue). "SLA" summarizes the deadline: "OK", "Warning" (more than half the time has passed), "Critical" (less than 2 days), or "Overdue".
Abriu a tela \"Extensões\" da empresa em: The "Extensions" screen for your current company opens, here Clínica Bem Viver. Because you administer the server, you see the "Guide work with new guides" box, labeled "Installation manager", with "Choose JSON file" and "Admit catalog": this is how a catalog enters the server. Below, on the "Installed" tab, each company's administrator enables a guide for their own team using the "Active in CRM" switch, then "Save configuration". Here both show "Disabled". The "Extensions" module teaches each action.
\"Adicionar lembrete\" cria outro aviso,: "Add reminder" creates another alert with its own lead time and message: for example, one the day before and another two hours before. With more than one, "Remove" appears so you can delete one. Under "Channel for sending reminders", the default "Automatic" uses the number from the booking conversation or, if the clinic only has one number, that number. If the clinic has several numbers, choose which one sends them: in automatic mode, a booking that did not come from a conversation gets no reminder, and the team receives an alert. Click "Save" to save everything.
A tela é uma página só, com várias lista: The screen is a single page with several lists stacked vertically. "Accounts" are where money is kept: the reception cash drawer, the bank account. "Payment methods" are the ways customers pay, and each specifies which account receives the money. That is why they sit together: at a glance, you can check that Pix goes to the bank account and cash goes to the cash drawer. The ⚠️ beside "Credit card" means this method has no account yet. You will fix this in the "Payment methods" lesson.
Na sub-aba \"Templates da Meta\" ficam o: The "Meta templates" subtab contains message templates approved by Meta. They are created in your WhatsApp Business account, and this screen only shows a copy. Without the official channel connected, you see "Official channel not connected": connect it first on the "Connection" subtab. After connecting, "Sync with Meta" retrieves the templates. Once 24 hours have passed since the customer's last message, only an approved template can be sent. The notice mentions "WhatsApp connections": this means the "Connection" subtab next to it.
Antes de aprovar, clique em \"Pré-visual: Before approving, click "Preview data". The window shows the customer's profile, with their email and phone partially hidden, and how many of their records exist in the system: conversations, messages, "Leads" (deals in the pipeline), orders, activities, audit entries, and consents. Opening this window sends and changes nothing. The window is called "Data subject preview". Under "Expand sample", you can see up to 10 examples of each record type. The CPF never appears in this preview.
No fim da aba \"Configuração\" fica \"Qu: At the bottom of the "Configuration" tab is "Who came from the website". The simplest approach is the capture URL: instead of a regular WhatsApp link, your page's button points to a system URL. It saves which campaign the person came from and opens WhatsApp with a short code in the text. "Which WhatsApp to send to" already shows the clinic's number. The text the person will send must keep "[ref:{token}]" at the end: that is where the short code goes. Without it, the Save button stays disabled.
Aqui cada pessoa da equipe ajusta a próp: Here each team member adjusts their own Google account after connecting it: they choose which calendars block their availability and which calendar receives new appointments. Without a connected account, only "Connect your account through Calendar" appears, linking to the Calendar screen where the connection is made. If it says "Syncing with Google is not available yet" there, the installer still needs to configure Google; until then, the calendar works normally but does not communicate with Google.
O último quadro, \"Audit recente\", list: The last box, "Recent audit", lists this person's latest actions recorded in the system, up to 50, from newest to oldest. Each row shows the action code (for example, "platform_admin.users_listed" means opening or filtering this people list) and the date and time. The screenshot shows Helena's profile, who uses the system daily, scrolled to the bottom. Someone who has not performed any recorded actions yet, such as Marina, sees "No audit entries found for this user."
O botão \"Assumir\" aparece quando o cli: The "Take over" button appears when the customer has a WhatsApp conversation and neither the conversation nor the deal is assigned to a team member. No one is looking after Sandra. Renata is being answered automatically. Gustavo's deal belongs to the AI agent: taking over assigns the conversation to you and silences automated replies there, but the deal remains assigned to the agent. It does not appear for Paulo because he already has a representative. Nor for Marcos: he has not chatted on WhatsApp yet.
Em \"Cole este endereço no botão da sua: "Paste this URL into your page's button" contains the ready-to-use URL. The fields in braces are only filled by Meta when included in the ad's URL parameters. If the page serves more than one campaign, the button must pass along what the page received, or the conversation will arrive without a source. Click "Copy URL" and paste it into your page's WhatsApp button. Then click "Save capture URL": the switch is already on, but the URL only works after saving.
Abrindo a tela de novo, a chave continua: When you reopen the screen, the switch is still off: the pause was saved, and the connection and number remain filled in for when you want to resume. "Send test" sends a real message to the saved number, saying the notification is configured and working. It works even with the switch off. Use it when changing the number to make sure it arrives. The test counts toward the clinic number's daily message limit, and you can send up to three per hour.
Em \"Demandas abertas\" fica cada pedido: "Open requests" lists each customer request that has not been resolved yet, with its status ("Open") and how long it has been open. When no one has agreed on what to do, you see "No next step defined". "Current request on this channel" is only a notice, not a button: it shows that this request belongs to this conversation. "Close request" records the outcome once the request is resolved. Click "Set next step" to note what happens next.
Salvo o endereço, o cartão \"Script para: Once the URL is saved, the "Script to install on the website" card, a little higher up, shows the script. This is the other approach: instead of changing the button to the URL, your website manager pastes this small piece of code once on every page and keeps the regular WhatsApp buttons. It remembers the source as the person browses and adjusts buttons for the saved number. Click "Copy website script" if you use this approach. If you change the number, copy the script again.
Além de nome, WhatsApp e e-mail, o formu: Besides name, WhatsApp, and email, the form can include your own questions. This source already asks "What is your goal?", with a list of options. "+ Add question" creates another: write the question and choose the answer type (short text, long text, number, currency, options list, or checkbox). "Remove" deletes the question. "Save questions" only becomes available after you change something. The answers are saved in the lead.
Alguns fluxos só colocam pacientes sozin: Some flows only enroll patients automatically if they are linked to a published agent: those using AI ("AI-written message", "Classify (AI)", or a wait where AI chooses the time) and those starting with "No-show confirmed by team", such as "No-show · reschedule those who missed their appointment". To link one, open Agents, click "Edit", and scroll to the "Follow-up" section. Turn on "Enable automatic follow-up triggers" and select the flow under "Published flows".
Em \"Status\", \"Perdidos\" mostra só os: Under "Status", "Lost" shows only deals that did not close; they stay in the loss stage, "Canceled", at the end of the board. With this filter on, "Reason" appears, separating losses by the reason chosen when marking them lost, such as "Price". "Category" may appear beside it, grouping losses by who caused them: the customer, the clinic itself ("Us"), competitors, or no response. It is a quick way to see why customers drop out.
Clique em \"Salvar\". Por alguns segundo: Click "Save". For a few seconds, "Connection saved." appears in the bottom corner of the screen. The token field becomes empty again, now showing "Stored — fill in only to replace", and just below it says "A token is already stored.": the token was saved but is never displayed again. The system does not test the token when saving. If it has expired or lacks the "ads_read" permission, a notice appears on the Meta Ads screen explaining what to do.
Os detalhes abrem na lateral: o nome do: Details open on the side: the appointment name, date and time, location, and note. The "Internal note" is a message for the person handling the appointment. Just below are the status (here "Scheduled", which is the same as "Confirmed" in the list) and who it is with. This meeting has no customer, so you see "Personal appointment, no linked customer." When there is a customer, "View contact" appears instead, opening their profile.
Embaixo de cada extensão, uma frase cont: Below each extension, a sentence counts the companies. For "First consultation guide", "0 of 2" means two companies have adjusted this guide (enabled or disabled it at some point) and neither currently has it enabled: no one sees this guide. Companies that have never adjusted it are not counted and do not see it either. "Enabled" here means the same as "Active" on the company screen. Beside it is the date the extension was installed.
Um follow-up é uma sequência de mensagen: A follow-up is a sequence of messages sent automatically to a patient who stopped replying. The "Flows" tab shows the clinic's flows. The "Queue" tab shows who is in or has been through a flow, when the next message goes out, and follow-ups the AI agreed on with the patient. To create a flow, use "Start from a template" (ready-made clinic texts), "New flow" (build from scratch), or "Import flow" (bring in an exported file).
Quando uma linha diz \"Não saiu\", a fra: When a row says "Not sent", the red sentence just below explains why. Here it was "The WhatsApp connection selected for notifications is offline.": the clinic's number was disconnected at that time. This notification is not sent again later. Check the number under Connections. If the list is empty, notifications have not been enabled yet or were just enabled: when on, at least the summary row appears every morning.
Cada plano tem os seus botões. 'Usar no: Each plan has its own buttons. 'Use for sign-up' makes it the plan for new sign-ups. Only one plan can have this role: first, click 'Remove from sign-up' on the current plan. 'Hide from companies' turns it into a negotiated plan. 'Archive' removes the plan from sign-up and plan changes, but existing subscribers stay on it. Once someone subscribes, the price and interval can no longer change: the system rejects the save. To change them, archive it and create another.
O primeiro quadro é a \"Verificação em d: The first box is "Two-step verification". When enabled, besides your password, the system asks for a 6-digit code that appears only on your phone. That way, if someone discovers your password, they still cannot sign in. The badge on the right shows your account's status: here it is "Disabled". Just below is "Require for team", visible only to the administrator. It is explained in the "Requiring team verification" lesson.
\"Confere antes de enviar\" mostra as ve: "Checks before sending" shows the checks the system runs on each agent message before it goes out. There are 14, in this order: if one blocks the message, the agent receives the reason and rewrites it. Most cannot be disabled, such as "Respect people who asked to stop". At the top, "Response style" is a separate setting for all company agents that replaces em dashes (—) with commas in messages; here it is off.
A aba \"Teste\" mostra como o agente res: The "Test" tab shows how the agent would answer an example message without sending anything over WhatsApp. The version to test (here the published v1) and AI model appear at the top. Write the message and click "Run test". The orange notice reminds you that the test uses credits from the AI provider. Since this example installation has no access key, we will not run the test here.
\"Aprovar\" cria a empresa com o nome do: "Approve" creates the company using the requested name and makes the requester its administrator. "Reject" closes the door to that account while approval is enabled: they see "Request not approved" and cannot request again. If they have an invitation, they can still join through its link. In either case, the system does not notify the person: arrange that with them. If approved, they just need to sign in again to start using it.
O painel abre na lateral. Em cima ficam: The panel opens on the side. At the top are the appointment details: "Who will be seen", "Appointment type", "Guest email", "Address", and "Note". Choose the type using the buttons (they appear when the clinic has more than one type); each shows its duration. The address defaults to the selected type's address, and you can change it. If "Who will be seen" is blank, it is a personal appointment without a customer.
Dê à fonte um nome que diga qual é o for: Give the source a name that identifies the form. Here, "Posture assessment form". Then choose the "Entry pipeline", the pipeline the contact will enter. "Entry stage" (the pipeline stage) becomes available only after choosing the pipeline. Under "Thank-you URL", paste your website's thank-you page. It applies to the CRM's ready-made form. Fill it in now: once created, the source does not let you change this address.
Clique na opção e escreva no campo abaix: Click the option and write what was decided in the field below. With "Done" or "Need customer information", the AI reads what you write and uses it to answer the customer. Write the decision clearly, including amounts and times. With "Cannot do it — hand over to a person", the text becomes a note for the team member taking over the conversation. Here, reception approved a 5% discount for Pix.
Esta tela guarda o endereço e a senha de: This screen stores the URL and access password (the key) for an external system, such as the clinic's medical records or management system. MCP is the name of the standard way for AI to communicate with another system. Saving it here does not make the AI use that system yet: here you only register and test the connection. The card's text states the rule: the address must start with https and belong to a public server on the internet.
\"Passados\" mostra o que já aconteceu n: "Past" shows what already happened during the period. Here we went back to last week by clicking the left arrow twice. Since the week has passed, the grid says there are no available slots. The badge shows the outcome: "Completed" when the patient came and "No-show" when they missed it. Those still marked "Confirmed" are waiting for someone on the team to report what happened, using "Completed" and "Missed".
Os três cartões dividem o total por orig: The three cards break down the total by source. "The team" counts what people on your team did. "The agents" counts what AI agents did on their own. "Automatic" counts what was done by neither a team member nor an agent: the system itself (for example, creating a deal when the first message arrives), an automation, or the customer. Below the number is its percentage of the total.
\"Editar dados\" abre os mesmos campos q: "Edit details" opens the same fields the company administrator sees under Settings › Company: name, legal name, CNPJ, email of the person responsible for personal data (DPO), time zone, language, currency, country, automatic cleanup of old media (and after how many days it is deleted), and the privacy policy URL. Change what you need and click "Save". Closing the window changes nothing.
Com \"Quem tem horário marcado vira clie: With "People with appointments become customers" enabled, every contact with an appointment gets the "customer" label; canceled appointments and no-shows do not count. When enabling it, the system asks for confirmation because people who previously had appointments also receive the label immediately. Click "Enable" to apply it or "Cancel" to back out. Disabling it later does not remove anyone's label. Only the administrator can change this rule.
A tela tem duas chaves. \"Cadastro apena: The screen has two switches. "Invitation-only sign-up" closes the door: only invited people can join. "Sign-up with approval" lets people create an account, but their company is only opened after you approve it. With both off, as on a new installation, anyone can create an account and open their own company. Existing account holders continue signing in normally, whatever you choose.
No fim da tela fica a \"Zona de perigo\": At the bottom of the screen is the "Danger zone". It permanently deletes the company's messages, conversations, deals, proposals, contacts, appointments, and orders, along with everything linked to them, such as notes and history. Use it to clear test data before serving real customers. The team, settings, pipelines and stages, AI agents, and connected WhatsApp numbers remain.
Antes de clicar em \"Remarcar\", confira: Before clicking "Reschedule", check that "Available slots for", above the grid, shows the appointment's type: offered slots follow that type. To reschedule an appointment with Carlos, first choose "Dental consultation" there. Changing the type inside the panel does not change the appointment's type. You can also drag the block to another time in the grid: Calendar asks before rescheduling.
Abaixo dos cartões fica \"Alertas ativos: Below the cards is "Active alerts". Each row is an alert, the same company can appear in more than one row, and the number in the corner tells you how many alerts were found (the count goes up to 20). Critical alerts come first, followed by the most recent. The list shows up to 10 rows and tells you how many were left out. When there are none, it shows "No critical alerts right now. All clear!"
Logo abaixo ficam as abas do agente. Voc: Just below are the agent's tabs. You start in "Configuration", where you build the agent. "Test" shows how it would reply without sending anything to the customer. "Capabilities" shows what it used, "Runs" lists each time it worked, "History" keeps the versions, and "Proposals" contains its suggested improvements. The last lesson covers Test, History, Runs, and Proposals.
Agora a lista mostra só os 2 pedidos de: The list now shows only the 2 data-copy requests, and the counter beside the filters says "2 requests". To show everything again, click "Clear filters": it only appears when a filter is active. Notice that the top alert turned yellow: it only counts requests shown in the list, and none of the data-copy requests is overdue, but one has already used more than half its time.
Com o token colado, ele aparece como pon: After pasting the token, it appears as dots so no one can read it over your shoulder, and "Save" becomes enabled. When saving, "Connection saved." appears and the token field becomes empty again, because the token is never displayed again. The system does not test the token when saving: if it has expired or lacks the "ads_read" permission, a notice appears on the Meta Ads screen explaining what to do.
Uma extensão é um guia pronto: um passo: An extension is a ready-made guide: step-by-step instructions shown in the CRM to guide the team, such as a script for booking the first consultation. It does not receive your patients' data or run anyone's programs: at most, a guide button opens a CRM screen, such as Calendar. The screen has two tabs: "Installed", what is already in your CRM, and "Catalog", what can be installed.
Escreva no campo de baixo. Quando está v: Type in the bottom field. When empty, it shows "Write a message…". Enter sends, and Shift + Enter adds a line without sending. The airplane button on the right also sends. The little star between the face and the field asks the AI agent for a suggested reply. The suggestion appears in a box above the field with "Approve and send" and "Reject": nothing goes out without your click.
A chave vem ligada: as regras que têm o: The switch is enabled by default: rules with the "AI decides" step let the AI choose. This default avoids breaking existing rules. The text below the switch name summarizes what happens if you disable it. Here, "model" means the AI, and the switch applies only to the "AI decides" step: the "AI-written message" action keeps working. The last lesson covers how to disable it.
A coluna \"Status\" tem dois selos. O de: The "Status" column has two badges. The top one says whether the person receives conversations now: "On duty" (switch on and within working hours, or no published schedule), "Outside working hours" (switch on but outside their shift), or "Off" (switch off). The lower one says whether they have the system open: "Screen open" or "No screen signal", with the time of the last signal.
Mais embaixo fica a \"Linha do tempo da: Further down is the "Operations timeline": events during the period, from newest to oldest. Each row shows the date and time, what happened, who did it, the deal, and the customer's name. When there is a reason, it appears just below: for example, which stage the deal was moved from and to. The deal name is a link. Click it to open the deal.
Hoje as duas linhas dizem \"Som do siste: Both rows currently say "System sound": the default sound. Click "Change sound" and choose an MP3, OGG, or WAV audio file up to 1 MB on your computer. The new sound applies to the entire team, and the row changes to "Custom sound". To restore the default sound, "Use system sound" appears. Changing and restoring sounds is available to managers and administrators.
Cada linha mostra o nome, o e-mail, o te: Each row shows the customer's name, email, phone, and labels (called "Tags" here). "Last activity" says when the last interaction occurred, such as a message: today and yesterday show the time, earlier days show the date. The "Status" column uses badges: "Active" means a regular customer, and "Blocked" means someone who asked to stop receiving messages.
Cada linha é um incidente. \"Quando\" di: Each row is an incident. "When" says how long ago it was opened. "Type" is the problem's code, in English. "Tenant" is the company where it happened; a dash means the problem affects the entire server rather than a company. "Severity" indicates how serious it is: "Critical", "Warning", or "Info" (just for your awareness). "Status" shows its progress: "Open" or "Resolved".
No alto, \"Quadro\" e \"Calendário\" tro: At the top, "Board" and "Calendar" change how you view the same pipeline. Calendar places cards on the days of a date field you create in the pipeline, such as the assessment date (the expected closing date is not included). This pipeline has no date field yet, so Calendar tells you that. Fields are created under CRM › "View everything in CRM" › "Pipeline stages".
Clique em \"Quem será atendido\" e digit: Click "Who will be seen" and type the customer's name. The list shows matching contacts; click the right one. When no contact matches what you typed, the list offers "Create" with that name to add the customer right there. The first option, "Personal appointment, no customer", lets you book time without a customer, such as a meeting.
Com uma pessoa escolhida, o funil passa: With a person selected, the pipeline becomes "Representative's pipeline" and counts only open deals assigned to them, and the table shows only their row. The "By channel" card also counts only their conversations. Friction, Losses, Forecast, and Wins by period still show the entire clinic. To return, choose "All representatives".
Na Odonto Sorriso Leve, o agente \"Lia —: At Odonto Sorriso Leve, the agent "Lia — Atendimento Sorriso Leve" is "Active". Under "Published version", "v3 · anthropic · claude-sonnet-4-6" means version 3, using Anthropic's AI with the claude-sonnet-4-6 model. "Published on" says when this became the version in use. For it to actually reply, the company also needs WhatsApp connected.
Clique numa peça para abrir os detalhes: Click a block to open its details on the right. Here, "How to write the message" is set to "Fixed text": the patient receives exactly the text in "Text sent to contact", without AI. The other options are "AI-written message" and "Ready-made message template". Your changes apply to the draft; to keep them, use "Save" in the top bar.
Para desmarcar, clique em \"Cancelar\" n: To cancel, click "Cancel" in the appointment's row. Here we will cancel Camila Rocha's Wednesday session. The panel requires a reason: enter at least 3 letters and "Cancel appointment" becomes enabled. The slot becomes available again and the appointment moves to "Canceled". "Back" closes the panel without canceling anything.
Acima fica a \"Assinatura (HMAC)\". Ela: Above is "Signature (HMAC)". It is only for those with a developer connecting another system: it protects the URL so only that system can submit contacts. Do not enable it if you use the ready-made form or a website builder: they cannot sign requests, and all submissions will be rejected. When enabled, the test button is also disabled.
Marque a caixa \"Devolver ao agente sozi: Check "Automatically return to agent after some time without a team response". The "Minutes without a team response" field appears, defaulting to 60. Time counts from the last human activity in the conversation: taking over, replying on screen, or replying by phone. After that time, AI resumes handling it, but only where there is a published AI agent.
Quando a venda vem de um anúncio que abr: When a sale comes from an ad that opens a WhatsApp conversation, Meta requires knowing which Facebook page or WhatsApp Business account it came from. Without this, Meta rejects the sale. Fill in only one field: "Page ID" or "WhatsApp Business account ID". Meta accepts either, not both together. Then click "Save".
Entre as ações, \"Avisar outro sistema (: Among the actions, "Notify another system (webhook)" sends data about what happened to another system's URL. That other system needs its own URL for receiving notifications. This is how the CRM communicates with a management system or tools such as Zapier and n8n, which can forward the notification, for example to a spreadsheet.
Em \"Mais ações\" ficam Arquivar, Pausar: "More actions" contains Archive, Pause AI, Return to automatic, and "Transfer to…". Each selected conversation receives the action as if you performed it individually. Pause AI disables automated support and, if the conversation has no owner, assigns it to you. Return to automatic removes the owner and lets AI handle it again.
Em \"Como seus e-mails saem\", \"Nome de: Under "How your emails are sent", "Display name" is the sender name customers see in automation emails. "Reply to" is the email address receiving replies when customers respond. The sending address remains the system's address.
